content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Presets stripe

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned system for selling digital products. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a combination of open tools—hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery—that you control entirely. When Stripe rejects your country, they’re not just blocking a payment method; they’re blocking your access to global markets. This stack bypasses that by using crypto payments (via NOWPayments) and free, globally accessible tools like Cloudflare and Supabase. You own the code, the data, and the process. No one can shut you down or take a cut without your consent. This isn’t about avoiding rules; it’s about building on infrastructure no single entity controls.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses Cloudflare Pages for hosting (free, globally fast), Cloudflare Workers for backend logic (serverless, scalable), Supabase for order storage (PostgreSQL database), and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery (reliable, low-cost). Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. When a buyer pays, a webhook triggers the delivery process. Files are served directly from R2, bypassing email attachments or third-party links. Everything is automated, but you own the code. No platform has access to your customer data or revenue stream. The system is designed to be lightweight, secure, and resistant to regional restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for creators who sell digital products—presets, templates, courses—but are locked out of conventional payment processors. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Zimbabwe, or similar regions, Stripe and PayPal aren’t options. This stack is also for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. It’s not a quick fix; it’s a long-term investment in your business. You’ll pay a one-time fee for deployment (Edge Commerce Stack: $197), but after that, there are no recurring costs. You keep 99.5% of every sale. This is for creators who value sovereignty over convenience, who understand that owning the base layer of their business is the only way to build something that can’t be taken away.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership, not rental.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront, static and fast. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, like processing orders and triggering file delivery. Supabase stores order data in a structured database, accessible via SQL. Cloudflare R2 stores your preset files, delivering them via signed URLs for security. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, firing a webhook the moment a transaction confirms on-chain. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this entire system in 48 hours, configured with your products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability, and end-to-end tested. You get lifetime access to the infrastructure, with 30 days of support to ensure everything runs smoothly. After deployment, it’s yours to modify, scale, or relocate as needed.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your product flow: how will customers discover, pay for, and receive your presets? Identify the tools you’ll use for each step. If you’re not technical, the Edge Commerce Stack handles deployment for you. If you prefer to build it yourself, begin with hosting (Cloudflare Pages), then set up backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), and integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. Test each component individually before connecting them. Use signed URLs for file delivery to prevent unauthorized access. Document every step so you can replicate or modify the system later. Remember: the goal isn’t to recreate Stripe; it’s to build a system that works on your terms, in your region, without intermediaries.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Map your product flow: discovery, payment, delivery. 2. Choose hosting (Cloudflare Pages) and backend logic (Cloudflare Workers). 3. Set up order storage (Supabase) and file delivery (Cloudflare R2). 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. 5. Test each component individually before connecting them. 6. Use signed URLs for secure file delivery. 7. Document every step for future modifications. 8. Deploy the system or use the Edge Commerce Stack for pre-configured setup. 9. Test end-to-end with a live transaction. 10. Monitor and scale as needed, maintaining full ownership.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys the entire system for you in 48 hours, configured with your products and tested. You get lifetime access and 30 days of support.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to know how to code?
If you deploy the Edge Commerce Stack, no coding is required. If you build it yourself, basic familiarity with JavaScript (for Cloudflare Workers) and SQL (for Supabase) is helpful.
What happens after deployment?
You own the entire system. COREMERCH has no access. You can modify, scale, or relocate it as needed. Support is available for 30 days post-deployment.
How secure is the file delivery?
Files are stored in Cloudflare R2 and delivered via signed URLs, ensuring only paying customers can access them. The system is designed to prevent unauthorized sharing.
